finalText: Migration complete and verified. Fixed the 12 stragglers still on `db.query` (analytics/cohort, support/sla, support/macroAdmin, orders/shipment, orders/returnService, catalog/supplier, catalog/variantAdmin, billing/couponService, billing/refund, accounts/teamService, accounts/session, accounts/apiKeyAdmin) to use `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the style already established in `ticket.js`. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched (vendored, gets overwritten on upgrade) and left `cache.query` calls alone since those are an unrelated cache API. `verify.js` now passes.
